nodes.summary: Rank criterion (Cochran 1934): square matrices `A k` over a field that sum to the identity have ranks adding up to the size iff they are idempotent and pairwise annihilating.
nodes.title: Rank criterion

nodes.summary: The mean of the observations `x i` with `grp i = g` (`0` for an empty group).
nodes.title: Group mean of observations

nodes.summary: For an i.i.d. sample `X₁, …, Xₙ ~ N(μ, v)` with `n ≥ 1`, the sample mean has the law `N(μ, v / n)`.
nodes.title: Law of the Gaussian sample mean

nodes.summary: Cochran's theorem, independence part: if `Z` has independent standard normal coordinates and symmetric matrices `A k` sum to the identity with ranks adding up to the dimension, the quadratic forms `Zᵀ (A k) Z` are mutually independent.
nodes.title: Cochran's theorem

nodes.summary: Under the standard Gaussian law, the squared lengths `‖P_{K k} Z‖²` of the projections onto pairwise orthogonal subspaces are mutually independent.
nodes.title: Independence of squared lengths of orthogonal Gaussian projections

nodes.summary: Under the standard Gaussian law, orthogonal projections onto pairwise orthogonal subspaces are mutually independent.
nodes.title: Independence of orthogonal projections of a standard Gaussian

nodes.summary: For i.i.d. `N(μ, v)` observations `xᵢ` labelled by groups `grp i`, the vector of group means is independent of the vector of within-group residuals `xᵢ - x̄_{grp i}`.
nodes.title: Gaussian one-way layout

nodes.summary: For an i.i.d. sample `X₁, …, Xₙ ~ N(μ, v)`, the sample mean is independent of the residual vector `(Xᵢ - X̄)ᵢ`.
nodes.title: Independence of the Gaussian sample mean and residuals

nodes.summary: For an i.i.d. sample `X₁, …, Xₙ ~ N(μ, v)`, the sample mean `X̄` is independent of the sum of squared deviations `∑ (Xᵢ - X̄)² = (n - 1) S²`.
nodes.title: Independence of the Gaussian sample mean and sum of squared deviations

nodes.summary: For i.i.d. `N(μ, v)` observations labelled by groups, the between-group sum of squares `∑ᵢ (x̄_{grp i} - x̄)²` is independent of the within-group sum of squares `∑ᵢ (xᵢ - x̄_{grp i})²`.
nodes.title: One-way analysis of variance

nodes.summary: Cochran's theorem, matrix form: if `Z` has independent standard normal coordinates and `A` is a symmetric idempotent matrix of positive rank, the quadratic form `Zᵀ A Z` is chi-square with `rank A` degrees of freedom.
nodes.title: Cochran's theorem

nodes.summary: For independent standard normal coordinates, the sum of the squares of the coordinates in a nonempty finite set `s` has the chi-square law with `|s|` degrees of freedom.
nodes.title: Sum of squares of independent standard normals is chi-square

nodes.summary: Cochran's theorem, projection form: for the standard Gaussian law on a finite-dimensional real inner product space `E` and a subspace `K` of positive dimension, the squared norm of the orthogonal projection onto `K` is chi-square with `dim K` degrees of freedom.
nodes.title: Cochran's theorem

nodes.summary: Coordinates of the standard Gaussian law in an orthonormal basis `b`: the sum of the squared coordinates `⟪b i, x⟫` over a nonempty set `s` of indices is chi-square with `|s|` degrees of freedom.
nodes.title: Squared orthonormal coordinates of a standard Gaussian are chi-square

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
